title: introduce-cost-orchestration-simulator-and-quant-compatibility-lab
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a cost orchestration simulator for tenant workload testing and a quantization compatibility lab that validates candidate quant profiles against representative micro-benchmarks. Includes CLI for dry-run scenarios.
description: Motivation: teams need a reproducible way to validate cost-optimization automation (batching, cache defaults, quant profiles) against representative tenant traces before rollout. Summary: this PR adds two components: (1) a cost orchestration simulator (cost-orch-sim) that replays sampled trace windows, simulates batching/caching/quantization decisions across tenant default sets and outputs unit-econ reports and tipping-point alerts; (2) a quant-compatibility lab (quant-lab) that executes candidate quant profiles against a micro-benchmark suite (latency, memory, decoding KL divergence and eval prompt quality) and emits compatibility tags and failure reasons. Design notes: the simulator uses deterministic replay with a seeded RNG, pluggable scheduling policies, and a configurable cost model so teams can test conservative and optimistic price curves. The quant-lab isolates model quality regressions using eval sets and small n-shot prompts to avoid noisy signal. Integration: outputs are JSON artifacts consumed by the defaults compiler and the Optimize suggestion pipeline; both consumer interfaces are backwards-compatible and feature-gated behind 'cost_orch_sim'. Checklist: [x] simulator core replay and scheduler abstractions, [x] quant-lab harness and microbench targets, [x] CLI (tools/opt-cli) for dry-run and export, [x] unit and integration tests, [x] telemetry hooks and CI job, [ ] full docs in docs/cost (follow-up PR). Testing summary: unit/integration added under services/* and services/quant-lab/tests; ran cross-tenant dry-runs for three tenant profiles and validated cost delta estimates versus smaller synthetic runs (median estimator improved by ~7% vs old heuristics). Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout, can enable per-tenant, monitor cost_synth_alert and quant_compat_failure metrics; rollback by disabling the feature flag and removing the defaults-import step. Impact: enables safer automation of batch/cache/quant presets and provides a mechanized vetting path for quant profiles prior to tenant-wide rollout. Related work: ENG-1842, ENG-1910. Merge: squash merged after approvals and CI green.
